- include receipt return state guard (AION-684)

- show saved receipt before supplementary checkout work

- allow verified settings access in local release tests
- guard checkout scrolling and stale startup work

- finish scoped reads and local volume testing

- preserve saved fuel proof during catalog upgrade
- reduce catalog sync and rule refresh stalls

### Other Changes

- verify existing repair rejection rollback
- align prepared versions and repair rejection guard
- align partial receipt QA with source returns (AION-684)

- fix paged kiosk quantity fixture
- bound search work and page every history section
- index history searches and isolate tab queries
- add portable local order volume fixture
- restore normal laptop launch configurations
- normalize local fixture schema whitespace
